caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with a reddish-brown finish, featuring a total of four drawers. Each drawer is adorned with two ornate brass handles and a central brass keyhole escutcheon. The sides of the chest are curved outward in a distinctive bombe (swollen) shape. The top surface of the chest is rectangular and flat. The chest stands on four rounded ball-and-claw feet, and there is carved detailing along the lower edge, especially at the corners and center. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or patterns, and the chest is centered within the frame.
title: Bombe Front Chest of Drawers
